items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, I did. Yes, I knew him, but never played with him, either.

ctx.x: What about Bobby Stark, was he also . . .

Oh, Bobby Stark, yes, he was a very fine trumpet player. He lived around the . . . actually, he lived on 62nd Street, which is the same street, I think, Bubber Miley lived on, and maybe even Thelonious Monk, but Thelonious came along much later. Oh, and who’s the other . . . another pianist named Ramirez, Roger.
